text_block_list.text:
On this day, I tagged along as her camera 
operator for a video call so she could 
show off her new outfit to the folks back 
home, but...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tome-san. Can you see me?

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
"Ah~, I can see clearly. Even so, what a 
gorgeous outfit~"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. My fans designed this outfit 
because they wanted me to shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Wearing this makes me feel so warm 
inside... It truly makes me feel like I 
can shine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... today, I intend to show everyone 
that side of me. Please watch how much 
I've changed...!

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
"Ohh, she's really running with such 
lively energy again now, isn't she~!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... My cornering... It's 
improved quite a bit, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
"Less about the corners and more like... 
everything! Nothing was even comparable to 
how it used to be!"

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text:
"Even on dirt, her legs used to hurt right 
away... But isn't she completely 
unstoppable now?"
...I wonder about that!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I heard all about it! If ya wanna call 
yerself the strongest, how 'bout ya beat 
me first? I was just thinkin' I wanted 
someone to train with anyway!"

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text: "Oh? Who is that child...?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Her name is Tama. She's my 
friend—and my rival.

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, rivals...! I'd definitely love to see 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Told ya so~! Come on now, ya wanna show 
everyone back home your true radiance, 
don'tcha?! Then what's the point if ya 
don't run with everything ya got?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. That's certainly true. Very well. 
I accept that challenge...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Hah... Sorry, but... I'm takin' the 
win!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No... The one who wins... is me...!

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
"Ohh! She's pulled right up alongside...! 
Go for it—! Oguri-chaaan!"

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, look at her running with such a 
smile... To think the day would come for a 
girl who always ran all by herself—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah~! So frustrating! I won't lose next 
time!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*... No, I will win the next 
one too.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now that I'm all fired up, I'm 
gonna go hit the training field right 
away! See ya later then~!

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
"...You really have wonderful friends. I 
was shown so many lovely things today... 
Thank you so much."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"No, after the race... there is a live 
performance. I would truly love for you to 
see that as well."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The live concert is the place where we can 
answer the fans who support us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
""...Ah, incredible. It's like it's truly 
shining...!""

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
"'To answer the fans' cheers'... Huh. 
That's probably why she trained so hard."

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text:
""Back in the day, she could barely keep 
rhythm, so clumsy yet so adorable... 
...and now look at her, she's grown up so 
wonderfully...""

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...How was it today? Was I able to show 
my radiance properly?"

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. You showed me so brightly, it was 
dazzling. ...You've truly grown, 
Oguri-chan."

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
"We will always keep cheering you on. Even 
though there may not be much left that we 
can do for you..."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, exactly. Everyone's support is the 
greatest source of strength of all!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because you supported me when my legs were 
weak and always cheered me on, I was able 
to shine this brightly...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This shine belongs to everyone. Always 
has, and always will...! I just want to 
make sure you know that.

text_block_list.name: Yone-san
text_block_list.text: "Fufu... Shige-san, are you crying?"

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, aren't you the one crying, 
Yone-san...?"
choice_data_list:
Looks like the message came through loud 
and clear.

Looks like your feelings really got 
across.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... don't you have anything to say, 
Trainer? Anything you want to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This radiance is also thanks to my 
Trainer, who has always supported me. That 
is why I would like to introduce them to 
you.
choice_data_list: I'll make her dream come true!

I may be inexperienced, but I look forward 
to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Tome-san
text_block_list.text:
“As expected of Oguri's Trainer! Please 
come visit us sometime too, alright? I'll 
be waiting with plenty of homemade dote-ni 
stew~”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, doteyaki! That's right. The doteyaki 
Tome-san makes is absolutely delicious!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm certain you'll love it too, 
Trainer...! Let's go together next time.

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
""N-No, the pleasure's all mine...! Even 
so, you're an amazing Trainer! Supporting 
Oguri-chan all by yourself and 
everything.""

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... Everyone used to 
support me, but now I'm supporting myself 
alone... That's amazing.

text_block_list.name: Shige-san
text_block_list.text:
"Seriously, man. Birthdays, Christmases, 
it was always such a pain... Well, she 
always asked for the same thing, so that 
part was easy, but—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
S-Shige-san... please stop already. It's 
really getting embarrassing...

Though Oguri Cap felt embarrassed, there 
was a distinctly happy look on her face.
